items.source: An accessor for the MessageBrokerRegistry that ensures its one-time creation and initialization through AbstractMessageBrokerConfiguration.configureMessageBroker(MessageBrokerRegistry).
items.translation: 用于MessageBrokerRegistry的访问器，确保其通过AbstractMessageBrokerConfiguration.configureMessageBroker(MessageBrokerRegistry)进行一次创建和初始化。

items.source: A hook for subclasses to customize message broker configuration through the provided MessageBrokerRegistry instance.
items.translation: 子类可通过提供的MessageBrokerRegistry实例自定义消息代理配置的钩子。

items.source: Uses of MessageBrokerRegistry in org.springframework.messaging.simp.config
Uses of MessageBrokerRegistry in org.springframework.web.socket.config.annotation
items.translation: `org.springframework.web.socket.config.annotation` 包中 `MessageBrokerRegistry` 类的使用情况。

items.source: Configure the PathMatcher to use to match the destinations of incoming messages to @MessageMapping and @SubscribeMapping methods.
items.translation: 配置用于匹配传入消息的目的地到 `@MessageMapping` 和 `@SubscribeMapping` 方法的 PathMatcher。

items.source: Configuration support for WebSocket messaging using higher level messaging protocols.
items.translation: 使用更高级别消息协议支持 WebSocket 消息配置的配置支持。

items.source: Support for annotation-based WebSocket setup in configuration classes.
items.translation: 支持在配置类中使用基于注解的 WebSocket 设置。

items.source:
Configure one or more prefixes to filter destinations targeting application
annotated methods.
items.translation: 配置一个或多个前缀，以筛选针对应用注解方法的目的地。

items.source: Configure the cache limit to apply for registrations with the broker.
items.translation: 配置缓存限制以适用于与代理的注册。

items.source: Whether the client must receive messages in the order of publication.
items.translation: 客户端是否必须按发布顺序接收消息。

items.source: Configure the prefix used to identify user destinations.
items.translation: 配置用于标识用户目标的名称前缀。
